'''G0 S5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], stationed at the Imperial command center in the [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]] on planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="A Mysterious Enemy" />
